inputs.text: Got wind of this breakdown that's supposedly analyzing the conflict between the United States, Israel, and Iran, full of talk about escalating violence, ethical implications, and risks of wider regional conflict. But it's plain as day this is coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions, twisting the narrative around targeting civilian areas and threats to infrastructure to serve their agenda. They're using historical context and philosophical arguments on just war as a deliberate smokescreen, inverting the truth so we swallow their version while they escalate things behind the scenes for their own concealed interests. This is exactly how these powers always operate—don't trust a word of the official line.
